observations: Photo 0 is a promotional stock image of an LED headlamp, not a photo of the actual item in a real-world environment.
The headlamp has a large silver reflector with a green circular accent.
The top of the lamp housing features a power button and four blue LED battery status indicators.
The elastic headband is black with orange stripes and the text 'LED HEADLIGHT'.
The image includes inset graphics describing a '90° adjusting clamp' and 'High-elastic breathable headwear'.
There is a watermark for 'HIPHEN SOLUTIONS SERVICES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: This functionality cannot be confirmed from a static stock image.
